caption: The video captures a diagonal column of pale, translucent liquid entering from the upper-left edge and slanting downward to the right, striking a dark, wet paved surface near the lower-right corner. The flow is already underway at the first frame and continues past the last, its entry and landing points holding fixed positions. At the impact site a bright white splash bursts upward amid scattered airborne droplets that shift shape and position from frame to frame. Over the sequence the jet's texture shifts, from a smooth, bulging ribbon in the early frames to pronounced breakup into droplets and jagged tendrils along its middle. The blurred background of green grass above a low curb stays fixed. A wet pavement patch and the bright splash persist throughout.
